claim: Domfront demands a majority of Plant de Blanc from standard orchards
because: The Poiré Domfront AOP rule is a minimum of 40% Plant de Blanc, not a majority (INAO product sheet: Plant de Blanc enters at more than 40%; AOC approved by arrêté of 20 December 2002).
fix: Domfront demands at least 40% Plant de Blanc from standard orchards
